column1: # One row per component, six TAB-separated columns:
#   id      stable name; --only/--skip and stdout findings (`<id>: <line>`) use it
#   shape   delta (judged against the fork of --base and HEAD) | tree (whole tree)
#   kind    suite (a tests/*.sh) | cmd (a command line) | builtin (a function in
#   argv    what runs, from the repo root; may contain spaces. `<fork>` is
#           replaced with the merge-base sha at run time
#   needs   comma list of binaries the component needs, or `-` for none. Never
#           empty: TAB is IFS whitespace, so `read` would collapse an empty
#           field and shift reason into needs
#   reason  one plain line saying what the component catches
